entries.name: Archcustodian
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The Dwarven Spider family is recognizable, but the exact Archcustodian encounter skin is unverified. Native views share a pose, but their elevated cameras are uncalibrated. Thin cables and joints may be lost in the mask or geometry.

entries.name: Count Ryelaz
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Only clay geometry is available. The named reference shows Count Ryelaz with folded wings and both feet visible. Extended wingspan, rear wings and side or rear armor remain unsupported; dark lighting and uncertain claw edges also limit the result.

entries.name: Exarchanic Yaseyla
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Only clay geometry is available. The reference shows the opaque main-phase Exarchanic Yaseyla, but its 449-pixel body falls below the 660-pixel target. Her hands rest at her hips with weapons sheathed; drawn grips and side or rear anatomy are unobserved. Manual masking and scene lighting remain uncertain.

entries.name: Green Ogrim
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Two elevated views show the same relaxed pose, but camera elevation is uncalibrated and no full profile is available. The mask may lose tiny neutral edges. Native RGB was preserved with padding only; photographed lighting and unseen surfaces remain unreliable.

entries.name: Dwarven Centurion
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The generic Dwarven Centurion is based on complete front and rear three-quarter views in the same pose. These are uncalibrated obliques; the generator labels do not establish cardinal cameras. Side surfaces are inferred, and disconnected neutral details may be lost in the mask.

entries.name: Dwarven Sphere
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The generic Dwarven Sphere is based on complete front and rear three-quarter views in the same pose. These are uncalibrated obliques; the generator labels do not establish cardinal cameras. Side surfaces are inferred, and disconnected neutral details may be lost in the mask.

entries.name: Gray Wolf
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The model uses one native oblique reference. Unobserved anatomy and surfaces are inferred, and the camera is uncalibrated. This texture projection remains experimental.

entries.name: Flame Atronach
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Orange torso and thigh fissures remain recognizable, but the crown becomes a dark face patch. Horns, shoulders, feet and sides contain broad dark fallback regions, and paint alignment fails around limbs and body landmarks. Horns, hands, feet and leg gaps disagree with the reference outlines. Near-cardinal front and rear plates provide no side evidence; profiles read as flat dark silhouettes at replay distance.

entries.name: Strangler
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The purple mouth, green tendrils and streaked stalk identify the creature, but petals, arms and mouth interior have broad purple or gray gaps. Profiles and rear use unsupported purple fallback. Tendrils intersect or collapse, roots flatten, and the rounded head and bent stalk have unobserved depth. The replay flower outline survives, but matching rear and profile captures are needed.

entries.name: Golden Lamia
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Golden scales and the pale underside remain recognizable, but the face becomes a mottled dark patch and fragmented paint leaves broad gold gaps. Arm contours and the lower coil disagree with the reference. Side and rear surfaces are mostly uniform gold; tail-coil depth, back scales and head-fin depth remain inferred. The near-frontal camera is uncalibrated, and the rear oblique was excluded from generation.

entries.name: Bull-Horned Magma Frog
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The horn and squat body identify a magma frog, but almost all orange fissures are lost to dark fallback. Registration disagrees around the horn, shoulders, toes and belly-to-leg gap. Horn lean, the rear projection and hidden anatomy are unverified, while hindlegs and toes appear flattened. All replay views read largely as dark clay; the uncalibrated frontal reference needs matching side and rear captures.

entries.name: Green Argonian Behemoth
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Front chest scales and thigh markings remain recognizable, but the head, horns and neck contain flat gaps and fingers are simplified. Rear tail and arm outlines disagree with the source, leaving fragmented dorsal texture; sides and the long tail are mostly fallback. The rear input is an elevated three-quarter view with uncalibrated alignment. This represents the ordinary green species, with no named boss identity accepted.

entries.name: Stone Atronach
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Scattered frontal stone detail survives, but broad gaps interrupt the surface and the rear and opposite side are mostly unsupported brown-gray fallback. Generated rocks and legs are rounded and fused compared with the native reference; baking does not repair those separations. The replay silhouette remains rocky, but face and limb detail is weak. This is the generic species, not Foundation Stone, and only one view was supplied.

entries.name: Red Harpy
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The face, chest, legs and parts of the lowered wings retain red detail. Outer feathers contain broad gaps, while rear and side surfaces are mostly unsupported flat red. Feathers become thick grouped paddles and talons are simplified; wing tips, feet and head also differ from the reference. The single hovering view is uncalibrated, so matching rear and side captures and feather review are needed.

entries.name: Crouched Banekin
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Only clay geometry is available. One native crouched front-three-quarter screenshot meets the body-size threshold without resizing; the smaller upright reference was excluded. Pose, unseen anatomy and surfaces require mesh review.

entries.name: Brown Bear
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Only clay geometry is available from one native oblique screenshot. The front input label is a generator slot, not a cardinal camera measurement. Matching rear, opposite-side and cardinal-front references are missing; hidden anatomy is inferred.

entries.name: Crocodile
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Only clay geometry is available from one native oblique screenshot. The front input label is a generator slot, not a cardinal camera measurement. Matching rear, opposite-side and cardinal-front references are missing; hidden anatomy is inferred.

entries.name: Kwama Warrior
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Only clay geometry is available from one native oblique screenshot. The front input label is a generator slot, not a cardinal camera measurement. Matching rear, opposite-side and cardinal-front references are missing; hidden anatomy is inferred.

entries.name: Haj Mota
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Only clay geometry from the repaired native-RGB run is included. Complete front and rear three-quarter plates provide approximate conditioning without camera calibration. Unseen surfaces remain inferred, and the invalid earlier texture diagnostic is excluded.

entries.name: Coral Haj Mota
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Only clay geometry from the repaired native-RGB run is included. Complete front and rear three-quarter plates provide approximate conditioning without camera calibration. Unseen surfaces remain inferred, and the invalid earlier texture diagnostic is excluded.

entries.name: Green Wamasu
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Front face, chest and near-shoulder detail survives, but broad sides become flat dark olive fallback. Rear alignment disagrees extensively over the torso, head and tail, and jaw horns and feet merge into coarse geometry. Replay front is recognizable while sides are blank dark masses. Both views are uncalibrated obliques; rear and side captures and geometry correction are needed.

entries.name: Green Daedroth
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Front face, chest and forearms retain some scales, but the tail, outer arms and sides use broad olive fallback. Rear head, tail and torso alignment is poor, leaving patchy texture; the head is flattened and feet simplified. The rear image is an uncalibrated three-quarter view with natural foot occlusion. Only the generic green species is supported, with no named actor identity accepted.

entries.name: Brown Gryphon — folded wings
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The face and white chest remain recognizable, but rear alignment disagrees over the head, back and tail. Sides and back are mostly flat brown with displaced blue wing patches. Feather layers become solid plates, the tail differs from the photographed fan, and crest spikes and toes are coarse. Both cameras are uncalibrated; rear and side alignment and feather geometry need improvement. The compact texture export reviewed exceeded the 400,000-byte target.

entries.name: Blue Daedric Titan
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Blue face and chest cues and some wing holes survive, but both fits disagree broadly over wings, arms, legs and tail. Rear wing detail is patchy, and side and rear body surfaces use dark fallback. The tail becomes a thick loop and wing membranes are coarse. Frontal wings remain recognizable at replay distance, but compatible calibrated views and wing, limb and tail correction are needed.

entries.name: Iron Atronach
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Front and rear alignment is comparatively strong, retaining chest fire, red fissures and several iron plates at replay distance. Sides remain flat brown fallback with abrupt seams, and spikes and hands are coarse. The elevated oblique cameras are uncalibrated; photographed fire and lighting are baked color rather than emission. Side captures and plate alignment are still needed, and no named actor identity is verified.

entries.name: Storm Atronach
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The disconnected floating rock form is identifiable, with patchy front and rear stone detail. Broad sides and many shoulder and boot surfaces become dark fallback, while fits disagree around shoulders, hands and feet. Detached rocks and fingers are simplified, and photographed depth is uncertain. Both elevated obliques are uncalibrated; side captures and rock and hand alignment are needed, with no named actor identity verified.

entries.name: Frost Atronach
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. Front face and chest and rear blue plate streaks remain recognizable at replay distance. Fits disagree around forearms and feet, rear texture placement is uneven, and sides become flat blue fallback. Head, shoulder and forearm geometry lose crystalline facets. Both elevated obliques are uncalibrated; side captures and plate registration and geometry correction are needed, with no named actor identity verified.

entries.name: Female Dark Elf Zombie
entries.reviewNote: Unaccepted draft. The frontal skull face and brown-red clothing remain recognizable, but legs and feet differ from the attack pose and palms and fingers are coarse. Rear and most side surfaces use unsupported uniform brown fallback; hidden anatomy and clothing are inferred. Only this pictured female Dark Elf zombie is supported, with no runtime alias verified. Matching-pose rear and side captures are needed.

provenance: Existing reviewed draft exports and publisher references. Reference thumbnails are resized display copies; model exports are copied unchanged.
limitations: All candidates remain unaccepted for replay runtime. Oblique cameras, inferred unseen anatomy, baked lighting and projection gaps remain unresolved. Clay-only candidates have no selected valid texture diagnostic. Invalid earlier Haj Mota inputs and textures are excluded.
